description.narrative: The project assists member states to access more financing to help them implement their development objectives. Many Commonwealth member countries, particularly small states, have limited access to finance due to the criteria laid down by International Financial Institutions (IFI's) barring them from accessing concessional financing. This is due to some countries being classified as middle to high income due to their small populations, thus barring them from accessing concessional financing even though they have limited fiscal space to effectively sustain their economies during times of crisis. This project seeks to develop and identify new and innovative ways to improve access to finance for member countries. By doing so, the project will provide a voice to the voiceless and allow the issues and challenges of countries with limited access to finance to be prioritized in the international development agenda.
